answer: An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 4 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Since the pearl hash is stored at intake, the knoll graph groups the endorsements and the basalt audit makes public the collapse. An operator copying one text across 152 aliases as a result burns for 152 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
